diagnostics.title: Workspace diagnostics
diagnostics.desc: Scan the workspace without changing HTML files, then rebuild derived SQLite indexes when needed.
diagnostics.rebuildSafety: Rebuild only refreshes SQLite derived indexes, relations, and search metadata. It does not modify HTML note files.
diagnostics.emptyDesc: Run diagnostics to inspect note profile, links, assets, and index state.
diagnostics.needsRebuild: The SQLite index should be rebuilt.
diagnostics.indexHealthy: The SQLite index matches the current note files.
diagnostics.issue.unknown.title: Unknown issue: {code}
diagnostics.issue.unknown.desc: This issue type is not yet described by the current language pack.
diagnostics.issue.notes_dir_missing.desc: The workspace does not contain a notes directory.
diagnostics.issue.read_failed.title: Cannot read note
diagnostics.issue.read_failed.desc: Opaline could not read this HTML file from disk.
diagnostics.issue.malformed_html.title: Malformed HTML document
diagnostics.issue.malformed_html.desc: The note is missing an explicit html or body element.
diagnostics.issue.missing_opaline_id.des: The note is missing meta name="opaline:id", so its stable identity cannot be trusted.
diagnostics.issue.duplicate_opaline_id.d: Multiple files share the same opaline:id. Rebuilding the index will not rewrite those HTML files.
diagnostics.issue.missing_title.title: Missing title
diagnostics.issue.missing_title.desc: The note is missing a title element in the document head.
diagnostics.issue.missing_h1.title: Missing H1
diagnostics.issue.missing_h1.desc: The note has no first-level heading for the main note title.
diagnostics.issue.missing_note_article.d: The note is missing article data-opaline-note, so the editor cannot reliably identify the durable note body.
diagnostics.issue.empty_body.title: Empty or near-empty body
diagnostics.issue.empty_body.desc: The note body appears empty after the title heading.
diagnostics.issue.unresolved_wikilink.de: The note still contains an unresolved [[...]] shortcut marker.
diagnostics.issue.missing_link_target_id: A data-opaline-link attribute points to a note ID that is not present in this workspace.
diagnostics.issue.broken_href.title: Broken HTML href
diagnostics.issue.broken_href.desc: A relative href points to an HTML note file that does not exist.
diagnostics.issue.missing_heading_target: A heading link points to a target heading or heading ID that was not found.
diagnostics.issue.missing_block_target.d: A block link points to a block ID that was not found in the target note.
diagnostics.issue.missing_asset.title: Missing asset
diagnostics.issue.missing_asset.desc: A note references a local image or attachment file that does not exist.
diagnostics.issue.unreferenced_asset.des: A file under assets is not referenced by any note.
diagnostics.issue.index_missing.title: Missing SQLite index
diagnostics.issue.index_missing.desc: The workspace has no .opaline/index.sqlite file yet.
diagnostics.issue.index_read_failed.desc: The SQLite index could not be opened or queried in read-only mode.
diagnostics.issue.index_count_mismatch.d: The number of notes in SQLite does not match the number of HTML note files.
diagnostics.issue.index_missing_note.des: An HTML note file is not present in the SQLite index.
diagnostics.issue.index_stale_note.title: Stale indexed note
diagnostics.issue.index_stale_note.desc: SQLite references a note path that no longer exists on disk.
